<!-- pr-reviewer: 530cb8c792ac046fdf1248f8f5214513a931177a -->
**Needs changes before merge** - the PR itself is sound, but it no longer compiles merged with current main (two test files added on main build `Tool` literals without the new field).

## What looks good
- `ToolCatalog` lives in `camcraft_tools::catalog_fields` (provenance line, 105 lines, own tests), so `crates/app/src` only holds the command gate, the DTO and the MCP schema text. No new `camcraft-*` dependency, no Cargo.toml / build.rs / `.github` / scripts change.
- No unwrap/expect/panic on user paths: the UI helix parse is `parse().unwrap_or(f64::NAN)` and NaN is refused by name (`catalog_fields.rs` refusal, `state.rs` `ToolUi::catalog`). Length, control-character and helix 0..=90 / non-finite refusals all by tool name at command creation; `Tool::is_sane` carries the same check so a hand-edited file is refused by tool name too.
- Component law: no schema change; the facts ride `Tool` inside the existing `ToolDef`. Commands: no new command; `AddTool`/`ChangeTool` carry them, and `add_tool`'s `definition` takes the keys. MCP edit and setup sheet are named follow-ups (#1062, #1063).
- Inert data: no generator, check or post reads it; no golden moved. No snapshot PNG changed. Decision file present and complete. Tests live in the owning crates (tools unit test, app test over app commands and project file, ui unit test).
- Project file: `ToolDto` gains five `Option` keys with `default` + `skip_serializing_if`, so old files load and tools without facts save byte for byte as before. Not a breaking format change and no version step needed; an older build skips the keys and loses them on its next save (stated in the decision file).

## Local results (PR head trial-merged with origin/main 90c711929)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-tools --lib` | 70 passed |
| app: tool_catalog_fields 7, tool_cutter_params 3, tool_cutter_profile 5, tool_law 4, tool_library 13, tool_list 6, tool_body 12, project_roundtrip 73, mcp 19, commands_undo 30 | all passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (cwd crates/ui) | 635 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -D warnings` | FAILED, 2 errors (below) |

```
error[E0063]: missing field `catalog` in initializer of `camcraft_app::tools::Tool`
  --> crates\app\tests\hole_wall_flats.rs:63:5
error[E0063]: missing field `catalog` in initializer of `camcraft_app::tools::Tool`
  --> crates\app\tests\thread_mill_rim.rs:153:5
```
Everything else compiled and was clippy clean. The gate maps a PR touching `Tool` literals across the app suites; the full app quick plan was not run beyond the suites above (time box), so other literals added on main are covered only by the clippy `--keep-going` result, which showed just these two.

## The two points asked
1. **`catalog_gate` on every `ChangeTool::judged` path, including `ReshapeTool`.** It cannot refuse an edit that was legal before: a stored tool can only hold facts that passed the same check (`AddTool`, `ChangeTool`, the DTO normalizes on read and `is_sane` refuses bad files at load), and both `ReshapeTool` callers (`mcp/cutter_tools.rs:98` clones the stored tool, `state_tool_cutter.rs:209` takes the editor draft built by `ToolUi::to_tool`) hand it the tool's existing facts unchanged; the gate only trims, which is a no-op on stored values. The only new refusal reachable there is a half-typed helix in the editor draft, which is a field that did not exist before. Undo/redo: `ChangeTool` keeps `prev` read from the world before the gate result matters and `invert` restores it whole, so the facts come back with the rest; `ReshapeTool::invert` calls `numbers.invert`. `editing_the_facts_is_one_undo_step_and_never_moves_geometry` pins undo/redo for `ChangeTool`. No test pins the `ReshapeTool` path specifically (a reshape keeps the facts, and a bad helix refuses it); that is reasoning from the code, not a test - a small test is welcome but not blocking.
2. **Closing keyword.** #898's "Done means" says the fields "show on the setup sheet, and are editable via UI and MCP". This PR does not show them on the setup sheet, and MCP has add only (edit is #1062). #1063 says "Part of #898" and #898's own text does not say a follow-up covers the rest, so `Fixes #898` would close it with the sheet display unshipped. Use `Refs #898` here and let the last piece (#1112 for the sheet, or #1062 for MCP edit, whichever the maintainer decides completes #898) carry the closing keyword.

## Requested before merge
1. Fix the merge with current main: add `catalog: Default::default()` (or the same `ToolCatalog::default()` form the PR uses elsewhere) to the `Tool` literals at `crates/app/tests/hole_wall_flats.rs:63` and `crates/app/tests/thread_mill_rim.rs:153`, and re-run clippy on `-p camcraft-app --all-targets`. Merge main first so any other newly added literals show up.
2. Change the body's `Fixes #898` to `Refs #898` (see point 2), keeping the `Changelog:` line.

## Notes (not blocking)
- `crates/app/src/commands/tool.rs` is 308 lines, `catalog_fields.rs` 105: fine. `crates/ui/src/state.rs` (4409) and `crates/tools/src/tools.rs` (720) were already far over 400; this adds 31 and 9 lines.
- The `ToolDto` doc says an older build "keeps no unknown-key refusal" - plausible, not tested here.
- #1060's Update/Replace still match by name; leaving part-number matching to the maintainer is reasonable.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
